- requirement: Issue #8072: "Move its slowest steps (see the run's step timings) into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged, keeping job and step names."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, the group-3-only steps of the `orchestrate-poll` job (lines 2479-2513), mainly "Orchestrator judges on the Claude engine tests (Phase 5c)" (guard line 2504) and "Validation harness sandbox tests" (guard line 2510)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Only one step (the unblock step) was moved although the issue says "steps"; the two remaining group-3 steps keep `if: strategy.job-index == 3` at lines 2504 and 2510; step timings were not obtainable (PyYAML missing in the sandbox) and the remaining steps were chosen by estimated cost; the expected outcome of group 3 finishing well under its timeout is not shown by the diff and depends on the next budget-watch run. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, NIT from the others.
- requirement: Issue #8072: "Move its slowest steps ... into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged" so that `orchestrate-poll (3)` stops risking its 20-minute timeout.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml orchestrate-poll group guards (the receiving group's load accounting), around lines 2472-2480
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Group 1 was chosen only because it "carries no moved-in steps since #7766", with no measured load. Run 40065164413 shows the step at 860 seconds inside `orchestrate-poll (3)` (analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-24-2.md line 66), so `orchestrate-poll (1)` may land near 19-20 minutes, above the 15-minute warning ratio. This would move the problem to group 1 rather than fix it. The diff has no measurement or guard against that. Severity MAJOR.

- TASK_GAP (confidence=3, severity=NIT; source ISSUE_CONFIDENCE=2)

  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, the group-3-only steps of `orchestrate-poll` (the unblock step, now moved, and the two #7689 steps guarded at lines 2504 and 2510)

The other two steps were "chosen by estimated cost, not measured" and may be heavier than the unblock step (about 28s in the #7690 timing). Run 40112590944 was only 8s over the 15-minute warning mark, so one light step may be enough. The constraints are met: `timeout-minutes` is still 20 and no job or step name changed. The PR states the fallback openly.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2469-2471 (comment) and line 2480 (step guard) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pre-existing comment block (lines 2457-2471) ends with "so this step runs in group 3 only, once per CI run", but the guard is now `strategy.job-index == 1`. The new #8072 paragraph (lines 2472-2478) below describes the move to group 1.
  WHY: No runtime effect, but it can mislead maintainers and budget-watch triage to look in group 3 when a failure would show under `orchestrate-poll (1)`, which the new changelog entry says.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:1099 (GROUP_PINNED_STEPS entry) and 1144-1192 (MovedPollGroupThreeStepsContractTest) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The step is registered in both `GROUP_PINNED_STEPS` (line 1099) and `MOVED_POLL_GROUP_THREE_STEPS` (line 1145). `MovedPollGroupThreeStepsContractTest.test_each_step_is_owned_only_by_the_poll_job` and `test_each_step_is_guarded_to_its_new_group` repeat what `PollGroupPinnedStepsTest.test_moved_steps_run_once_in_their_group` (lines 1116-1129) checks. Only `test_each_step_still_names_its_modules` and `test_group_three_keeps_at_least_one_extra_step` add coverage.
  WHY: Both classes pass, but this differs from `MOVED_RELEASE_STEPS` (line 1199), `MOVED_POLL_GROUP_TWO_STEPS` (line 1254) and `MOVED_HOOKS_JOB_STEPS` (line 1317), whose steps are not in `GROUP_PINNED_STEPS`. A guard change must stay consistent in two places.
- TASK_GAP (severity=NIT, confidence=3)
  Requirement: Issue #8072: "Move its slowest steps (see the run's step timings) into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged, keeping job and step names. Do not raise timeout-minutes and do not split tests into new required job names." Expected outcome: "Group 3 finishes well under its timeout, and the next budget-watch run confirms it."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, the remaining group-3 steps "Orchestrator judges on the Claude engine tests (Phase 5c)" (lines 2503-2507) and "Validation harness sandbox tests" (lines 2509-2513), guards at lines 2504 and 2510
  Evidence of absence: Only the unblock step's guard changed (line 2480). The other two keep `if: strategy.job-index == 3`. The timings were never obtained, so the PR cannot show the moved step was among the slowest or that the two left behind are not also slow. Group 3 still carries two steps the ci.yml comment (lines 2485-2492) calls "that job's most subprocess-heavy steps". The PR defers the question to the next budget-watch run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2466-2470 (versus guard at line 2480) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The #7690 comment still says "so this step runs in group 3 only, once per CI run", but line 2480 is now `if: strategy.job-index == 1`. The new #8072 paragraph (lines 2472-2478) sits directly below it.
  WHY: No runtime effect, but it misdirects maintainers and budget-watch triage to `orchestrate-poll (3)`. The group 1 rationale (merge-train step) no longer holds since #7766 moved that step out.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:1156-1192 (duplicating 1116-1129) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `GROUP_PINNED_STEPS` (line 1099) already pins this step to group 1 and `PollGroupPinnedStepsTest` already asserts single owner, the guard string and `group < poll_group_count()`. The new class's `test_each_step_is_owned_only_by_the_poll_job` and `test_each_step_is_guarded_to_its_new_group` repeat all three. Only `test_each_step_still_names_its_modules` and `test_group_three_keeps_at_least_one_extra_step` are new.
  WHY: Nothing breaks now, but a future guard change needs edits in two places, and one defect can fail both classes.
- TASK_GAP (severity=MAJOR, confidence=3)
  Requirement: Issue #8072: "Move its slowest steps (see the run's step timings) into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged" so that `orchestrate-poll (3)` stops risking its 20-minute timeout.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml orchestrate-poll group guards (the receiving group's load accounting), around lines 2472-2480
  Evidence of absence: Group 1 is justified only by "carries no moved-in steps since #7766" (ci.yml lines 2473-2474), not by measured load. Run 40065164413 shows the moved step at 860 seconds (~14m20s) inside `orchestrate-poll (3)` (analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-24-2.md line 66). The "28.2s" figure came from the #7690 implement sandbox, where the step failed at collection (ci.yml lines 2475-2477). Poll groups otherwise record about 5 minutes (ci.yml line 2467). If 860s is representative, `orchestrate-poll (1)` lands near 19-20 minutes, above the 15-minute warn ratio (CI_BUDGET_JOB_WARN_RATIO 0.75 of 20m). That would relocate the defect to group 1. The diff has no measurement or guard against it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
